The '''''Dahome''''' was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It was present at the [[Battle of Organarms]].
